css      v.css:7  transition of -webkit-transform  =>  RmlUi has no such property: dropped
css      v.css:8  transition: all 0.2s, opacity 0.3s ease-in  =>  RmlUi takes `all` only on its own: kept the `all` item; the other items' timings are lost (write the properties instead of all)
css      v.css:12  linear-gradient() interpolation in oklab  =>  RmlUi interpolates gradients in sRGB: dropped (colours between the stops may differ)
css      v.css:14  radial-gradient() position right 25% bottom 10dp  =>  RmlUi takes two values (x y): an offset from bottom needs the box size; written as bottom, give the offset as a % or from left/top
css      v.css:17  -webkit-radial-gradient()  =>  the prefixed form has its own syntax: write radial-gradient()
css      v.css:21  background position 10dp 20dp  =>  RmlUi's image alignment takes px or %, not dp: written in px (the same at a dp ratio of 1; give it in % to scale)
css      v.css:22  background position right 10dp top 5dp  =>  RmlUi takes two values (x y): an offset from right needs the box size; written as right, give the offset as a % or from left/top
css      v.css:22  background position 5dp  =>  RmlUi's image alignment takes px or %, not dp: written in px (the same at a dp ratio of 1; give it in % to scale)
css      v.css:25  background linear-gradient() sized 50% 50% at 0 0  =>  RmlUi's gradient decorators fill the box: written filling it (give the gradient an element of that size and place, or use a repeating gradient)
css      v.css:26  background repeat round  =>  RmlUi tiles at the natural size: written as repeat
css      v.css:29  background position 1dp 2dp 3dp  =>  RmlUi aligns with two values (x y): centred instead; write it as two values
